title: Workflow [Backups]
description:
## Backups
Databases crash. Servers die. People run DELETE without WHERE. Backups save you.

### Common strategies:
- **Full backup**: Copy the entire database periodically
- **Incremental backup**: Only back up what changed since last backup
- **Point-in-time recovery**: Replay transaction logs to restore to any moment

In SQLite:
```bash
sqlite3 mydb.db '.backup backup.db'
```

In PostgreSQL:
```bash
pg_dump mydb > backup.sql
```

The golden rule: **If you don't have backups, you don't have data.**
